WEYLAND-YUTANI CORPORATION
CLASSIFIED OPERATIONAL ORDER XO-7
PROJECT PROMETHEUS — PHASE 3 ACQUISITION

AUTHORIZATION LEVEL: OMEGA
RECIPIENTS: SCIENCE LEAD, VESSEL COMMANDER

1. PURPOSE
Secure live specimen from Sigma Draconis IV survey site for delivery to Gateway Station BioResearch Facility P-7.

2. ASSET PROTECTION
The specimen is the primary asset. Human crew are secondary assets. In any conflict between specimen survival and crew survival, the specimen takes priority.

3. COVER IDENTITY
Cargo manifest will list container as 'Seegson Synthetic Resin (Industrial Grade).' Vessel commander is briefed under separate cover story. Science lead knows the full picture.

4. EMERGENCY PROTOCOL
If the specimen breaches containment: DO NOT destroy it. Attempt recovery. If recovery is impossible, signal W-Y immediately and await extraction. DO NOT signal for external rescue — exposure risk.

5. CREW DISPOSITION
If crew members are exposed: quarantine. Do not allow evacuation off-vessel. The specimen cannot be permitted to reach open stations.

SECTION 5 AUTHORIZED BY: W-Y Executive Office
LEGAL REVIEW: Approved under Appendix F (Biological Asset Recovery)

[End of Order XO-7]
